name: Jesharelah
title: Levitical Choir Director
summary: Jesharelah (Jesjohaja) was one of the sons of Asaph and served as leader of one of the 24 musical groups that King David organized for temple service. He was a Levite responsible for praise and worship in the house of the Lord. His name is mentioned in connection with the seventh lot drawn for the temple music ministry.

keyEvents.title: Appointment as Choir Director
keyEvents.description: Jesharelah was appointed leader of the seventh of the 24 musical groups that served in the temple, following a lot drawn under King David.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Asaph in Temple Service
keyEvents.description: Jeshoshah was among the sons of Asaph who prophesied with harps, lyres, and cymbals under the king's leadership as part of organized worship.

keyEvents.title: Organizing the Temple Music
keyEvents.description: David and the commanders set apart the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun for service, and Jeshoshah received his assigned role among the 288 trained musicians.

keyEvents.title: Casting Lots for Service Order
keyEvents.description: The seventh lot fell to Jeshoshah, and his group consisted of twelve members—his sons and brothers—who were to serve in the temple.
